description: Bionic Labs is building TerraTrace, an interactive Earth-system trend platform. It uses monthly NASA POWER records to explore how environmental variables change across locations and over time. Users select a variable and place, examine deseasonalised time series, and assess trends using the Mann–Kendall test, Sen’s slope and linear regression. We welcome collaborators in Earth science, climate research, statistics, GIS, data analysis, software development and science communication.
